title: Grand Theology Synthesis — Presence, Access, Life & Restoration
purpose: Register the September 11 archive unlock in which previously scattered biblical parallels are reorganized into a coherent Presence→Access→Life→Restoration theology, along with three newly promoted biblical microcosms.

events.title: Biblical parallels crystallize into Presence–Access–Life–Restoration theology
events.subject: Grand biblical-theological synthesis
events.summary: The archive recognizes that Garden, Tree, River, House, Gate, Ladder, Temple, Zion, Door, Way, Spirit, Body and New Jerusalem form a larger canonical problem of divine presence, ruptured/guarded access and restored life rather than a loose list of symbolic matches. The synthesis explicitly remains comparative and does not treat resonance as supernatural proof.
events.source_direction: 2026-09-11 archive synthesis; earlier Tim statements remain separately dated

events.title: House, Vine, Body, Temple and City are unified as integrated-plurality models
events.subject: One-and-many / participation theology
events.summary: The archive promotes a new systematic category: House/household, Vine/Tree, Body, Temple/living stones and City are distinct biblical images that each preserve differentiated members inside a real common order. This becomes a control against center-totalization and role collapse.

events.title: Ephesians 2 emerges as a compact Father–Son–Spirit / House / access microcosm
events.subject: Ephesians 2:11-22
events.summary: A fresh Bible sweep promotes Ephesians 2 as an unusually dense sequence: alienation→nearness→dividing wall removed→reconciliation→access to Father through one Spirit→citizens/household→foundation/cornerstone→temple/dwelling. The passage strengthens access/House theology while making reconciliation and peace a central corrective.

events.title: Hebrews 6 and Psalm 118 reconfigure Anchor, Gate and Rejected Stone
events.subject: Hebrews 6:19-20 / Psalm 118
events.summary: Hebrews 6 supplies a positive target-anchor: hope enters behind the veil where Jesus has gone as forerunner, correcting the tendency to treat anchor/leash imagery only as restriction. Psalm 118 links spacious rescue, life, gates of righteousness and rejected-stone/cornerstone reversal in one salvation sequence.
